name: How long does it typically take to install molding in a standard bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install molding in a standard bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for bathroom molding depends on the size of the bathroom, the complexity of the design, and the type of molding material chosen. For a standard small to medium-sized bathroom with basic baseboards and door casing, installation typically takes one to two days. More intricate designs, custom cuts, or additional elements like crown molding or window trim may extend the project duration. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project requirements during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing molding in a standard bathroom usually takes one to two days, but complex designs or additional elements can extend the timeline.
